caseName: Portland Pipe Line Corp. v. Environmental Improvement Commission
caseNameFull: Portland Pipe Line Corp. v. Environmental Improvement Commission and American Oil Co. v. Environmental Improvement Commission

opinions.text:
Appeals from Sup. Jud. Ct. Me. dismissed for want of substantial federal question. Mr. Justice Stewart would dismiss appeals for want of properly presented federal question.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these appeals.

Reported below: 307 A. 2d 1.
